featured_reviews.name: Ashish Bidlan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was a student of the 2022 batch, studying in the 12th grade with a science stream. Whenever someone asks me about this college for admission, I always tell them one thing: either don't pursue further studies or, for God's sake, don't even think of taking admission here. This place is a nightmare.

I still remember every single detail of the torture they put me through to get my hall ticket. Can you believe it? They were getting the practical book corrected and handed me my hall ticket just four days before the board exams! Four days! It felt like pure mental harassment. They showed zero empathy or professionalism, just plain incompetence and indifference.

There was this elderly physics teacher—probably retired now—and what she did was beyond infuriating. After making me stand in line for two whole days, she bluntly refused to sign my practical book, saying there was no prior signature in it. How ridiculous is that? Does she not realize the stress a student goes through before board exams? That old woman, despite her age and experience, acted so insensitively. And because of her, I had to rewrite the entire practical book from scratch. TWO DAYS of my life wasted on something that could have been resolved in minutes! Only after this ordeal did she finally sign it. How heartless can one person be?

And if that wasn’t enough, there was another so-called teacher sitting nearby who had the audacity to say, "It’s fun watching students stand in line like this every day." Fun?! Watching students suffer is fun for them? These people don’t deserve to call themselves educators—they’re nothing but tormentors hiding behind the guise of teachers.

Even now, I can’t get over how they made me go through this madness just four days before my board exams. Four days! The frustration, the anger, the helplessness—I wouldn’t wish this on my worst enemy. If you’re even remotely considering this college, let me save you the trouble: don’t. It’s not worth the misery.
